newsitem.title: ESTONIA: C.BANK HEAD SAYS NEW GOVT TO MAKE NO CHANGE.
newsitem.headline: C.BANK HEAD SAYS NEW GOVT TO MAKE NO CHANGE.

text.p: Estonia's central bank governor Vahur Kraft said on Friday that the change in government would not affect the country's economic reform.
"We don't see any changes," Kraft told Reuters in an interview.
"The new prime minister has said that he will continue the last government's policy and this policy will be the open economy, balanced budget for reporting the strong fiscal and monetary policy.
Mart Siimann is the candidate for prime minister and is currently putting together a government that has to be presented to the president by March 19 at the latest.
